meta.title: Irosekai 斓世 — A world woven in code
meta.description: Irosekai (斓世 / イロセカイ) is a small developer collective that treats colour and craft as first principles. Tools, interfaces, and things worth making.

hero.tagline: A whole world, woven in code and painted in spectrum.
hero.subline: We build tools, interfaces, small games, and anything else worth making. Not minimal for its own sake — memorable on purpose.

marquee.line: IROSEKAI · 斓世 · いろせかい · COLORED WORLD

about.title: A dev collective that thinks in colour
about.lede: "Lán" is multicoloured. "Shì" is the world. Together they name the thing we do: turn complicated technology into something with a hue.
body: Irosekai started in 2026, out of a few people tired of grey interfaces. We don't believe software is only a tool — it can have temperament, texture, a reason to hold your eye two seconds longer.
Our output spans developer tooling, experimental interfaces, small games and infrastructure. Small in volume, but everything is finished, polished, and in the open.

items.title: Beautiful first, usable always
items.body: Aesthetics aren't decoration; they're part of usability. We make the thing people want to touch, then make sure it holds up.

items.title: Open source by default
items.body: With rare exceptions everything lives in the open. You can read every line, and rewrite every line.

items.title: Small team, slow craft
items.body: We don't chase volume. Three finished things a year beats thirty mediocre ones.

projects.title: Things currently taking shape

empty.title: Quiet in here, for now

join.title: We don't need to be big. Just bright enough.
join.body: If you also think "beautiful" and "usable" shouldn't be a trade-off, come talk. Open an issue, or send a PR — we're friendly to strangers.
